{{Top|leg}}
The '''Arakyd Probot Series''' was a series of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Araykd Industries]]. The company entered the [[Explorer droid/Legends|exploration droid]] market with models like the [[Prowler 1000 seeker droid/Legends|Prowler 1000 seeker droid]],<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> retroactively dubbed the "Probot 1.0,"<ref name="The Droids of Episode III">{{InsiderCite|81|The Droids of Episode III: It's a Junkyard Smackdown!}}</ref> and Arakyd's first probot, the [[Realspace/Legends|spacegoing]] [[Vanguard probot]],<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids" /> which had a design inspired by the probes build by [[Galalloy Industries]].<ref name="Arakyd Probot Series">{{FactFile|6|PRO 1-2|Arakyd Probot Series}}</ref> They were followed by the [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]], [[Infiltrator probe droid]], and [[Hunter-Killer probot]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids" />
